notes: Added 2026-10-03 for Web Tranche 1: WebKit's CMake (Source/cmake/WebKitCommon.cmake, find_package(Gperf 3.0.1 REQUIRED)) needs gperf to generate perfect-hash tables for WebCore. It is a build tool that runs on the build machine (a C++ program that depends only on the C++ runtime), built as a CRT port like every other tool the project owns rather than taken from the host.
3.3 is the newest release in ftp.gnu.org/gnu/gperf as of 2026-10-03; WebKit requires >= 3.0.1. No upstream patch.

build.sysroot_stage=02-cxx: gperf is a C++ program, so it builds against the cumulative 02-cxx SDK (libc++) instead of the C-only 01-c sysroot every earlier recipe used (tools/crt-port-build.py port_sysroot_for(); the CMake port-build target depends on crt-libcxx-sysroot). build.env.CRT_CXX_HOSTED=1 makes tools/crt-c++ pass -fhosted: CRT compiles C++ with -ffreestanding, under which `main` is an ordinary function and an unmodified `int main(int, char**)` gets a mangled name that crt1 cannot call. Removal condition: when crt-c++ is hosted by default.
build.env.CRT_CXX_ENABLE_EXCEPTIONS=1: gperf's lib/arraylist.cc does `throw std::bad_alloc()`, and tools/crt-c++ compiles with -fno-exceptions unless a port opts in.
